works.title: Define the event timestamp contract
works.intended_outcome: Give clients a stable UTC timestamp representation.

facts.statement: Define the event API's timestamp representation so every client interprets the same instant.
Return ISO 8601 timestamps in UTC to remove ambiguity between client time zones.

works.title: Parse event timestamps in the client
works.intended_outcome: Render API event times in the viewer's local time zone.

facts.statement: Implement the client parser against the agreed event timestamp contract.
The client parser depends on the API's UTC timestamp contract before it can reliably convert event times for display.
